Hiya C2C.

My apologies, I have only just noticed your post! I really appreciate your comment, comments like this mean a lot to me.

I just opened up my platform and by chance happened upon this nice level
on AU. There was a strong push into it, which gave me confidence to
touch trade.

My entry was actually based on the orders in the far right arrow (not
very noticeable in this TF), but it was clear that if the level broke
(which it did) there would be sufficient orders just above which was
nearly guaranteed to bounce price. Its always nice to have a safety
blanket.

Hi buddy. It's something that is very hard to know, but to be honest, I
have long left looking at wicks behind. Waiting for wicks to form to
give conformation is risky (as you say, you dont know if order are being
consumed to push through or not) and is bloody horrible for your RR!

I really don't use them at all anymore
